visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with reddish-brown hair is seated in a racing simulator cockpit at a professional racetrack. She wears a white tracksuit with black stripes on the sleeves and large earring studs. Her face shows worry as she looks over her shoulder. Grandstands and large brand logos like HONDA and BRIDGESTONE are visible in the background under an overcast sky. (2) A young boy with black hair is seen from a rear perspective, operating a small electric vehicle on a track lined with green trees. The lighting is bright and natural. (3) Two boys are on a concrete ramp; one pushes the other in a black wheelchair. They are dressed in casual t-shirts and backpacks. (4) Two boys are seated on a mechanical amusement ride, holding onto metal bars. The ride structure, made of brown beams, extends upward against a clear blue sky. (5) A first-person view follows the ride through green, vine-shaped sculptural arches. (6) Back in the small car, the woman screams with her eyes closed and mouth wide open. Cartoonish yellow stars rotate above her head as she grips the steering wheel. (7) Close-up of the woman outdoors, shouting enthusiastically at the camera. Large stylistic text appears around her head. (8) A black and white sequence shows the woman looking upward with a despairing facial expression. (9) A boy with glasses stands in a modern indoor lobby, looking directly at the lens with a flat, awkward expression. (10) Inside a brightly lit restaurant, the woman uses a fork to eat a translucent blue jelly. A small inset image shows the dish. Upon tasting, her eyes widen significantly in a shocked expression, and a row of exclamation marks appears at the bottom of the screen.
